title: FIPS counter under rwlock prevents lookup race
description: fips_provider_count is an atomic_t but is always read/written while holding provider_lock (write_lock on register/unregister, read_lock on lookup). This ensures the fips_mode snapshot taken at the start of crypto2dev_lookup_algo is coherent with the provider list being traversed — no TOCTOU window exists between 'FIPS mode on?' and 'which providers are visible?'. A reviewer might suggest removing the rwlock from the fips_mode read (since it is an atomic) — that would reintroduce the race: a FIPS provider could be added between the atomic read and the first list_for_each_entry, making a non-FIPS provider visible in the window. Do not move the atomic_read outside the read_lock.
close_reason: Acknowledged: already implemented correctly, no code change required
